## What it is

- The **1959 Super Lead** came out in **1965**, built for Pete Townshend's search for volume; its Plexiglas front panel (to 1969) gave it the nickname **Plexi** (Wikipedia, "Marshall Amplification").
- **100 watts**, from KT66 and then **EL34** valves, into closed **4x12** cabinets: the Marshall stack (Wikipedia).
- Its ancestor, the JTM45 (1963), was almost a copy of the Fender Bassman, with higher-gain ECC83 valves and a filter after the volume that brightened it (Wikipedia).
- Players: Townshend, Hendrix, Clapton, Page (Wikipedia).

## How it makes its sound

- Two channels, **High Treble** (Volume I) and **Normal** (Volume II), each with two inputs. Players link them with a short cable, **jumpering**, so both volumes mix: Volume I for bite, Volume II for body (Wikipedia mentions linking inputs).
- The tone stack is the same circuit as the Bassman's, with other values, **after** the second valve and a cathode follower that clips softly on the way up. The **tone stack** (Treble, Middle, Bass) is a passive network of three capacitors and resistors: it can only cut. This page computes its curve exactly from the component values, with the formula Yeh and Smith published in 2006 (checked there against a circuit simulator); the graph under the panel shows it.
- No master volume: to get it to distort, the whole amp is turned up, and the **power valves** clip too. **Presence** brings back treble the negative feedback removes.

## The amp

The Marshall 1959 Super Lead "Plexi"'s control panel, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click a switch, then press a ▶ button. ## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="plexi" data-set="{&quot;vol1&quot;:3,&quot;vol2&quot;:2}" data-play="chord"><p><b>Both volumes low.</b> Loud and fairly clean.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="plexi" data-set="{&quot;vol1&quot;:7,&quot;vol2&quot;:4}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Volume I 7, II 4.</b> Classic crunch.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="plexi" data-set="{&quot;vol1&quot;:10,&quot;vol2&quot;:10}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Everything up.</b> Full Plexi roar.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="plexi" data-set="{&quot;vol1&quot;:3,&quot;vol2&quot;:9}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Volume II up, I down.</b> Darker, thicker.</p></div>
<div class="amp-step" data-amp="plexi" data-set="{&quot;vol1&quot;:8,&quot;vol2&quot;:5,&quot;presence&quot;:9}" data-play="lead"><p><b>Presence 9.</b> More bite on a lead line.</p></div>
```
